_comment: The catalogue plan. K, 2026-11-01: unlimited songs, any genre, AR plans the catalogue. Each genre carries its own Flow Music style prompt and its own Thai tagline, so a new song needs only a lyric file with `# GENRE: <id>` in its header. `mood` stays the fallback for the original 20 Thai songs. K, 2026-11-13: 'พักแนวลูกทุ่ง เพื่อชีวิต ไว้ เอาแนวป็อป แดนซ์ ร็อค' — lukthung and morlam are PARKED (status: parked; no new songs, excluded from the catalogue total) and the focus genres pop / edm (dance) / rock take the freed capacity. A parked genre keeps its style and tagline because its existing songs still resolve their sound and tagline through it.
